# DemoShop shipping policy
Fictional training policy, version 2026-10-26. Applies only to the DemoShop example.

## Delivery time and coverage
DemoShop ships within India only. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days after dispatch in eligible postal codes. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays. Processing before dispatch takes up to 1 business day.

## Shipping charges
Standard shipping is free for an order subtotal of INR 999 or more after discounts. Below INR 999, standard shipping costs INR 79. Express shipping costs INR 149 regardless of order value. Availability is shown at checkout.

## Tracking and delays
A tracking link is emailed after dispatch. Tracking updates can take up to 24 hours. If delivery is more than 2 business days past its estimated date, contact support with the order

# DemoShop returns policy
Fictional training policy, version 2026-10-26. Applies only to the DemoShop example.

## Return eligibility and window
Clothing and footwear may be returned within 14 calendar days after delivery. They must be unused, unwashed, with original tags and packaging. Start a return from My Orders and select the item and reason. A purchase receipt or order number is required.

## Exclusions
Gift cards, personalized products, and opened hygiene products are not eligible for change-of-mind returns. A damaged or incorrect item must instead be handled under the damaged-items policy, including excluded categories.

# DemoShop refunds policy
Fictional training policy, version 2026-10-26. Applies only to the DemoShop example.

## Inspection and refund timing
A returned item is inspected within 2 business days after reaching the warehouse. If approved, the refund is initiated within 1 business day. Banks or payment providers may then take 5 to 7 business days to credit the money. These periods start at different stages and are not counted from the pickup date.

## Refund destination and amount
Prepaid orders are refunded to the original payment method. Cash-on-delivery refunds are made to the bank account supplied through the secure return form. Never share bank details, passwords, or OTPs in chat. Refunds cover the eligible item amount actually paid, less any applicable extra pickup fee. Original shipping charges are not refunded for change-of-mind returns. Original

# DemoShop cancellations and changes
Fictional training policy, version 2026-10-26. Applies only to the DemoShop example.

## Before dispatch
An order may be cancelled from My Orders before dispatch, without a cancellation fee. The cancellation refund is initiated within 1 business day, then may take 5 to 7 business days to reach the original payment method. Unpaid cash-on-delivery cancellations require no refund.

## After dispatch
An order cannot be cancelled after dispatch. The customer may request an eligible return after delivery under the returns policy. This chat assistant explains policies but cannot cancel an order or submit a return.

# DemoShop damaged items and customer support
Fictional training policy, version 2026-10-26. Applies only to the DemoShop example.

## Damaged, defective, or incorrect items
Report a damaged, defective, or incorrect item within 48 hours of delivery through My Orders. Upload photographs of the item, packaging, and shipping label through the secure form. Keep the packaging until the case is resolved. Support reviews the report within 2 business days. Approved cases qualify for a free replacement if stock is available, or a refund. Pickup is free. The 48-hour reporting rule applies even to categories excluded from change-of-mind returns.
